meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.Admissibl: The interface index identifies `Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.admissiblePotential_holds` as a provider with the expanded result. Its source location and identified use are recorded there.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.FinalCellSystem.FormD: The full interface is constructed as the local fact `hForm` at FinalChain.lean:1681 inside `fractional_breakdown_of_cell_system_of_parts`. It has no separate top-level declaration name.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.AtomAxisI: The quotient is selected by choice when the factorization exists and defaults to zero otherwise; later factorization theorems establish the intended branch for admissible nonzero harmonics.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.AtomGradO: The two subtractions occur in natural numbers, where subtraction is truncated at zero.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.AtomSlope: The definition uses choice for an existing quotient and a zero fallback; later hypotheses establish the factorization before it is used.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.deriv_van: Lean's derivative is defined as zero at points where differentiability fails; the proof uses that convention at the cutoff as needed, so this equality does not assert that a classical derivative exists there.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.inverseSq: The conclusion chooses a representative equal almost everywhere to the displayed remainder; its mode-vanishing assertion holds pointwise on every ring for that representative.
